transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I, uh... I guess I came in because I've just been... well, I keep beating myself up lately. I just feel like I'm not really senior material at work, you know? Like I've somehow fooled everyone into thinking I can handle more than I actually can. It's just... getting to me.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried most days, even when there isn’t a specific reason for it?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I worry about the job, but... not for no reason. Just... regular stress, I guess. I don't really get anxious out of nowhere.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I guess so. Just... most days lately, I've had this heavy feeling. Like everything's just kind of low. I just go through the motions at work, and then at home, and... it's just like the color is turned down on everything, I suppose.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or have a lack of energy most days, even when you haven’t done much physically?

Yeah... I suppose so. Just... drained, I guess. By the time I get home from the office, it's... well, even simple things feel like a lot of effort. Like... checking the mail, or just loading the dishwasher. It just takes more out of me than it should.
Have you had trouble focusing on tasks, making decisions, or thinking clearly lately?
Not really. I mean... my focus is fine, I guess. I still get my work done at the computer and everything. My head feels clear enough... I just haven't really noticed any issues with that.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or that you’re letting people down, even when there’s no clear reason for it?

Um... yeah, I suppose. That's... part of why I decided to come in, honestly. I just keep beating myself up lately. Thinking maybe I'm not really senior material at the office. Just... I don't know, feeling like I fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. It's... yeah.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been more or less every day for at least two weeks, or has it been going on longer than that?

Um... it's been a while, I guess. If I really think about it... these low periods, the guilt... it's been coming and going for... maybe eleven months or so. Not every single day, but... yeah, it's been around for a while.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or lost interest in things, along with several other symptoms like changes in sleep, appetite, or feeling guilty?

I mean... I guess the real noticeable part... like the up-and-down stuff... that started about a month ago. It was right after they asked me to cover the senior analyst duties at work. So... yeah, about a month.
Was there a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, along with other symptoms like changes in sleep, appetite, or feeling guilty?
I don't... I don't really think so. Not two whole weeks straight, anyway. Like I said, it just kind of comes and goes. I haven't really kept track of the other stuff.
Can you recall if there was a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, and also experienced other symptoms like changes in sleep, appetite, or feeling guilty?

I mean... didn't we just cover this? I really don't remember it ever being two full weeks straight. It just... fluctuates. I don't really pay attention to my sleep or my appetite that closely, so... no. I don't think so.

Can you think back and tell me if there was ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, and during that time, also noticed changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy level?
Look, I... I really don't know how many different ways I can say it. I haven't noticed anything like that lasting for two weeks. It's just... I haven't.
Have you stopped enjoying things that used to make you happy, like hobbies or time with friends and family?

I guess... yeah. I mean, usually I look forward to grilling on the weekend, or going fishing... maybe putting on a record. But lately... I don't know. I just leave the stuff sitting there. I just don't really care right now.
Have you completely stopped enjoying things that used to make you happy, like hobbies or time with friends and family?
I thought I just answered this. I don't know about completely... like I said, I'm just not really doing those things right now. I don't have much else to say about it.
Would you say that you no longer get any pleasure from things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends and family?

I feel like you keep asking me the exact same question. I... I really don't know what else you want me to say. It's exactly like I just told you. I'm just not doing those things right now. That's all I've got on that.
Would you say that you no longer feel any pleasure or enjoyment from things you used to like, like hobbies or spending time with friends and family?

Look, I... I don't really know why we're still on this. It's the exact same answer. The grill, the fishing gear, the records... they're all just sitting there. I just don't care about doing any of it right now. Can we please just move on to something else?
Can you recall a time in the past year when you felt down or lost interest in things for several days in a row, and during that time, also noticed changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy level?
I guess... yeah. If I look back, those kind of low periods... where I just feel bad about everything, they've been coming and going for a while. Maybe eleven months or so. Just... off and on.
Would you say that you no longer feel any pleasure or enjoyment from things you used to like, like hobbies or spending time with friends and family?

Doc, I... I really don't know how else to answer this. We just talked about it. Like I said, normally I'd look forward to the weekend... firing up the grill, maybe doing some fishing, or just putting on a record. But lately I just leave all that stuff sitting there. I just... I don't really care right now.
Would you say that you no longer feel any pleasure or enjoyment from things you used to like, like hobbies or spending time with friends and family?

I... didn't I just answer this? I don't know what else you want me to say about it. Like I told you... the grill, the fishing gear, the records... I just leave it all sitting there. I don't care about doing any of it right now. Nothing's changed since the last time you asked.
Would you say that you no longer feel any pleasure or enjoyment from things you used to like, like hobbies or spending time with friends and family?
Look... I really don't have anything else to tell you about this. You keep asking me the exact same thing. My answer hasn't changed.
Would you say that you no longer feel any pleasure or enjoyment from things you used to like, like hobbies or spending time with friends and family?

I... I really don't get why you keep asking me this. Is there something wrong with your notes? 

Yes. Like I've said three times now... the grilling, the fishing, my records... I just leave it all sitting there. I don't care about it right now. I don't have a different answer for you.
